whatsappMessage:
Hi Dr. Abhishek,

I noticed your clinic has a stellar 5.0★ rating on Google in Kankarbagh, Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online patient appointment bookings.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, dental treatment services, aur clinic location details integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/abhishekdental

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Dr. Abhishek, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke dental clinic (Abhishek Dental Clinic) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp appointment booking and your Kankarbagh location details. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact treatments, actual clinic photos aur timing setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
